1.bug_scenario: On page load, a stylesheet is fetched via <link rel="preload" as="style" onload="this.rel='stylesheet'">. The CSS endpoint deliberately waits 5 seconds before responding. In Lighthouse’s Performance > Diagnostics panel, the preload request (slow.css) appears as part of a “Critical Request Chain” and reports a multi-second blocking chain, even though rel=preload should load the resource with “High” priority but not block initial render.
